# TANDEM Research Grant Award

::: {.post-meta}
Jun 10, 2026
:::

`r img_html("news_isrec", alt = "TANDEM Research Grant", class = "post-image", style = "width: 80%; display: block; margin: 0 auto 20px;")`

We are excited to announce that our lab has been awarded a TANDEM Research Grant from the ISREC Foundation for experimental cancer research!

We're receiving this funding for a 3-years collaboration project with Nina Cabezas-Wallscheid from the ETH Zurich, which will focus on the metabolic crosstalk between leukemic stem cells, macrophages and T cells.



- [Read the news on the University of Basel website](https://biomedizin.unibas.ch/en/newsdetails/two-tandem-grants-by-the-isrec-foundation-strengthen-translational-cancer-research-at-the-dbm/)


:::
